review_text: It’s my second visit to this place. Staff are very accommodating and they proactively keep our helmets inside, foods are delicious! Worth every penny. Note: you can also bring food from diff store. 🥰
overall satisfied with everything! been here many times already—whether it’s for dinner dates with friends, family gatherings, and study outs. their iced spanish latte is my ultimate fav!

We went their at 4-5 pm so we are captivated by the place. We enjoy the food with the calm ambiance. We can only hear the music they played. Soon we want to experience the ambiance at night together with the live band which is a perfect spot to unwind.
This one was one of the best coffee shops I have ever visited. The view and atmosphere was exquisite, not too windy, but the air was invigorating. Been there twice.

They just changed their name and menu but Coffee drinks are still available which is great. We love how they turned this rooftop into a business, much more a Cafe to just chill and hangout with friends until morning! Just be careful with the stairs going up as its too narrow. Would definitely visit this again, located in Sandawa, open from Sunset to Sunrise. Visit their FB page and follow for updates.

Me and my teammates went straight to Rooftop after our shift 4:30am. We had our breakfast there. Nice ambiance, cozy, and aesthetic. Staff are friendly. Food is okay, i recommend the Cheesy Chicken Fillet Meal for only 179php and they have huge serving! I ordered Cheesy Steak Meal (beef) for 199php and it's not worth it. It has a lot of gristle on it (chewy part of the beef or inedible part of the beef). I partnered it with iced tea and it was refreshing (apple iced tea for only 25php). All meals are served with 2 rice and an egg. When we went there, all sandwiches are not available. It was a bad timing as well, we were waiting for a sunrise but it was chilly has an overcast day (cloudy since it's about to rain).

Chill place to hang out alone or with friends, love the friendly and inviting vibe here. The food and the drinks are great too. The ambience is awesome and if the weather is nice with a light breeze, takes it up a notch. Limited parking, so take a taxi or public transportation here.

I’m from Butuan and a big coffee lover. I arrived in Davao just past midnight and was craving coffee or matcha. Thankfully, Rooftop was just around the corner from the bus station. I really liked the vibe when I went upstairs—despite the late hour, the staff were still accommodating and even suggested some great food and drinks. I’d definitely come back the next time I’m in Davao!

Surprised to see that this place is available for freelancers, BPO people and alike. Took a grab taxi from Blue Lotus Hotel and had a coffee. Nothing too fancy on the menu so if you're a foodie, there's nothing much to look forward to. Crew is friendly so you can always ask but as a newcomer and not much of a people-person, I would've appreciated the full use of their QR codes instead. Hope you enjoy!

Place is nice but customer service is really not giving, almost 10 minutes of waiting for food no water served, coz walay available na water kung wala giduol sa among kauban. Hope you do upgrade your customer service. Really dissapointed a night supposed to be a celebration for us.

The rooftop cafe and bar is 24 hours open with a nice and it has modern ambiance ( a white with wood accent ). The place is very unique and you can get a nice view of the sunset and the city. And also it is very accessable because its just right beside sandawa road.

Good food is good mood. Be prepared to take the stairs! The area's not so big so better visit when not peak hours. They serve alcoholic drinks together with some yummy pulutan! Self serving pay after you order 😘 …

We arrived around 7am na. I've been craving frappe however may ingredients na out of stock na so available lang nila long black then refreshers. 😭 Medyo ma init na din since late na nga kami pumunta. They have sockets if you prefer to work there make sure to be early para secure yung seats. Foods are great naman. Masarap din yung Sunrise lemonade. Their employes are also good They greet you when you arrive and when you left. You may check their menu by visiting their Facebook Page.

Go here if you have that late night cravings. Manage your expectations a bit. You can have good conversations here. Edit: Second visit we ordered mock tails. Got Blue Lagoon & Bob Marley’s, all good! The view not so much.
The vibes is very aesthetic and the view is really good. All the food that we ordered are very delicious and the staff’s? They are all accommodating 🫶

This place definitely downgraded. It used to be nice, but this place didn't feel well-maintained anymore. They don't even wipe or cleanup the tables right away (even when the place wasn't busy at that time). The last time I went here (very long ago) I was disappointed as well, I thought they improved but I guess they didn't. Even their "Comfort Room" dont feel comfortable, there was a cockroach while I was there.
Good staff and very friendly. Food is served immediately. The ambiance is great.
Got here a few minutes after sunrise. It was peaceful and quiet. Nice place to enjoy sunrise. However, I think the sunset looks better here.
Not accessible to people with mobility issues since it’s on the 4th floor, no elevator. We only tried their drinks and OK naman. I wish they used metal or paper straws :)

I love the place! Actually, it was just really random visit and we never expect that the drinks which is coffee, the view, the vibes and the customer service is great!! One of the best café. Must visit.
Cozy place, people are accomodating and food is nice at di tinipid. Me and my squad will definitely be back here
I love the vibe, the food and drinks are great

This place is good for chilling and relax and about the food is very good and super affordable and the staff is so approachable and this is my first time to dine-in this place so perfect to us with my bestfriend very good for food for the staff and the place are so good i love it.
The best place to unwind and hangout with friends. Best place if you’re looking for specialty coffee. Yummy foods!
Their food is pricey but its great. A really nice place to chill.
Feel the pristine air of Davao at Rooftop Cafe Bar. Recommended to spend time with your barkadas till sunset.

I had high hopes for this spot, but unfortunately, my experience was disappointing. The food servings were surprisingly small, especially the shrimp, which was underwhelming for the price. As for the ribs, they were a major letdown—so tough that the meat was literally stuck in my teeth. It was nearly impossible to enjoy. Service was equally frustrating. Not only did the food arrive late, but we were also told we couldn't order rice because they were "still cooking it." This was extremely inconvenient and felt like poor planning on their part. Overall, I wouldn't recommend this place. The food was subpar, and the service left much to be desired. A real disappointment for what could have been a great dining experience.
Place is nice during night time and early morning when the sun burst.
Love their food and coffee. Recommend everything!

we asked recommendations about the food so we got their platter, then we asked if since the price is kinda high, we made clear if it served for 1-2 person or just for 1. they told us it was for 2-3 person then the food came and it was literally just 6 pieces (of shrimp) paunsa masigo sa 3 ka tao? they could have told us nga isa ra diay to katao. misinformation kaayo we end up order a new type of viand then the food and dark hot choco served literally warm. wala gyd init samong gikaon. service was poor, or maybe because i thought it was a fine dining. atmosphere was kinda off but its fine. first time experience pero wala mi nag enjoy kay nag look forward mi so expectation got 📉.

Cheesy Chicken Steak: chicken was a bit dry. cheese sauce was delicious. German Franks: delicious Hungarian Sausage: delicious Chicken Wings: my favorite on the menu, so far! Sunset Lemonade: refreshing ade! They're serving is really big! You get two cups of rice each Rice Meal order. The atmosphere is really nice and cold. You get to see the city lights and the night sky. Though, I wish they'd lower down a bit of the volume of their music since it kind of gets in the way of our conversations. Or maybe try a mellower genre of music. Best part of the experience was the staff! They were so nice and welcoming 🥰

I won't let this night to end without letting go of the disappointment that I felt. We ordered chicken wings in two different flavors, when the order finally came, me and my girlfriend was so DISAPPOINTED with how it turned out. The chicken wings was so THIN, SMALL, and it feels like it won't even reach my stomach. I didn't expect this kind of food, I don't know if we were the only one to experience this. Hopefully, you will be able to reconsider your meals if you think that your customers won't be satisfied. Halata naman siguro sa laki pa lang ng chicken na hindi siya worth it i serve, barely may laman, halos buto nalang. I was so frustrated when I saw the serving pero just to respect kasi maraming customers that time, I didn't cause a scene nalang. Sana man lang, aware din ang in charge sa size ng chicken if justifiable ba siya i serve. We don't have photos to prove our claim kasi nga sino pa ba ang gaganahan mag take ng picture kung yun na ang nasa harapan mo, we had no choice but to eat it since sayang din naman, we were so hungry and tired to argue and complain pa. I hope you'll understand where we are coming from, we won't make this review naman if hindi kami na disappoint ng grabe. We ate sa place na yan not once but twice na, and we was also disappointed during our first dine, but nag give mi ug another try. Pero yun nga still disappointed.

Second time we went, this time to eat. It is alway hot, no air ciculates. Maybe invest in a fan or two. Didn't have the food (burger) we wanted to try. Didn't have the soda (coke), even I saw it in the fridge. Offered Pepsi but it was out also, ended up with sprite which we got about 5-6 minutes after our food which came with no plates, no napkins and no ketchup for the fries. We won't be back.

they said that the 310 buttered shrimp was for 3 persons yet it was just good for 1 lol, 6 shrimps for 3 persons ??? and the foods was not hot when it was served. not worth it. i don’t recommend this place
The food is good and not too pricey. Great place and ambiance is relaxing. It looked like a expensive restaurant but very affordable. The staffs are approchable and friendly. Must try here in davao.
You could never go wrong with ROOFTOP! Food, drinks, ambiance, staff, everything's perfect. Deal-breaker, for me, are their cocktails! Affordable but you can taste quality!
Affordable and good food!! A must visit place indeed😉 …
good ambiance despite the rain
Loved the city night lights. Perfect for that quick night out. Their mocktail menu is perfect for someone like me who likes to defer from alcohol.

I like the egg drop, it was my first time tasting such dish.i love it and I enjoyed the food and the ambiance of being in a rooftop while eating

The food is good and the customer service is superb However, there is one mistake that could've affected our appetite There was tissue in their salad😞 Though I know it is not intentional We still ate it, but be more cautious when serving the food and double check moving forward🙏 And we noticed that they were also surprised when I told them about our concern It's good that they apologized for the customer service because they were very accommodating And another thing, they have a lot of servings in the food🙏

4/10 🤧 I don’t know what happened Rooftop cafe the first time we ate here 2022 it was delicious but now.. Sisig is supposed to be served sizzling— it could give your customer salmonella. And the sauce for the chicken and white sauce is the same as the burger— it really disappoints, we don’t know the taste. In fairness, the bagnet is delicious. The only nice thing about your place is your staff who are accommodating and smiley. Please improve

It's okay to hang out, chat with friends because they're there until the morning. I've been here a few times and the place has improved. Food is okay, service is okay. Last time the cashier kept looking, coming back and asking about our order because he kept chatting with his friends while dealing with customers. I told him to focus on ours so he wouldn't come back. Other than that, it's okay. I'll still go back there 😄

A clean cafe with a great view... Enjoy sitting all night in peace and quiet with a variety of drinks at good prices... Open all day, closing at 9 AM and reopening in the afternoon. A wonderful experience.

Overhyped. Underwhelming. 3/5 maybe because I went early in the morning. I don't get the hype anymore. They said they ordered chicken ala max, it's not really tasty and it's a bad combo. strawberry drink is not giving and there are still lumps in the milk that didn't dissolve. the sound system is annoying to listen to because the music is already stopped, it's stressful to listen to, just don't turn it off 🙁 hopefully it will improve. will try to go back at night time.
Nice place, just choocks, the drinks are yummy, and the staff is friendly..

Save yourself and PLEASE DO NOT EAT HERE. The place is nice, it's nice to have a restaurant open so early. But the food. 😫😫😫 I hope they invested in the place, the chef, and the chewer. The tapa is delicious. 🥹 And the sisig is sweet. 🥹🥹 We went for breakfast, not a snack. 🥹🥹🥹 We're just hanging out here. Order a coke. 🙃
had a simple dinner date with my GF it was better than what i expected, the place was good and spacious. it's a shame you can't see the view if you're not in the corner seats. Overall 👍

Visited for the first time today. The only good thing is the place, the wait for the food is soooo long. We thought it's okay, we're here, I hope the wait for the food is worth it, but no, it's not worth it. I'm not sure if we were just impressed or what by the nice reviews that are more than the sisig, but we can perceive the bitterness more than the fire of the sisig. The extra rice was forgotten, even after giving a reminder to the person who served, we finished eating the extra rice and it has not yet arrived, so we refunded it. Our drinks have already melted, the food has not been served yet. Overall, our first time experience is not good at all. I hope in the future, if we decide to come back, some services will be improved. This is not to drag the establishment down but to give our honest feedback based on what we've experienced and to let them know what areas they need improvement with.

I've been there once but to be honest the experience was great :) Lami kaayo ang foods jud way char, also the ambiance , ma appreciate kaayu for sunset and sunrise also at night nindot kaayu ang view cuz of lights :)

Food - small serving especially the shrimp only 5-6 pieces are small; the ribs are very tough Service - long serving; at that time, we were hungry for rice because it was still soggy Place - just good Overall, we were disappointed. I wish it would improve.

We're back in 2024. The place is still open. Last 2022, we ate out here with my co-workers for a mini farewell party, at that time they were still planning for roofing, nice ambience, it was cool. I cannot remember my order but I was not satisfied with the food that time because the meal served was with sliced cheese only not melted but there was no disappointment because of the taste of their eggdrop sandwich uWu. Now in 2024 we ordered Iced Matcha Latte only and it was nice because we were there for the Live Acoustic night which is every weekend only. It's priceyyyyyy but to think that you are on the rooftop, nice ambience, Live acoustic music, and good customer service, I'd say you get your money's worth :)
